cues: The first tool is a restriction enzyme, the molecular scissors.
Bacteria make them to chop up invading viruses.
Each one recognises a short palindrome: a sequence that reads the same five prime to three prime on both strands.
E co R one looks for G A A T T C.
text: The first tool is a restriction enzyme, the molecular scissors. Bacteria make them to chop up invading viruses. Each one recognises a short palindrome: a sequence that reads the same five prime to three prime on both strands. E co R one looks for G A A T T C.
